chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥasan ibn Mayyāḥ, from his father, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me: “O Mayyāḥ, a dirham by which the Imam is supported is greater in weight than Uḥud.”

key_terms.أَعْظَمُ وَزْنًا: greater in weight; having more value and merit
key_terms.أُحُدٍ: Uḥud; the mountain used as a measure of immense magnitude
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the Imam; the divinely appointed leader
key_terms.دِرْهَمٌ: a single dirham; a small unit of wealth or money
key_terms.يُوصَلُ: is delivered or conveyed; here, given in support

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of giving wealth in support of the Imam in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the immense spiritual worth of financially supporting the Imam عليه السلام. Even a small amount given in connection with the Imam carries a weight and merit surpassing something as عظیم as Mount Uḥud.
